dict.string: Commands and connectors you run from Lumo need access to files in your Desktop folder.
Commands and connectors you run from Lumo need access to files in your Documents folder.
Commands and connectors you run from Lumo need access to files in your Downloads folder.
Commands and connectors you run from Lumo need access to files on a removable volume.
Commands and connectors you run from Lumo need access to files on a network volume.
